name: Featherine Augustus Aurora
original_name: フェザリーヌ・アウグストゥス・アウローラ
source: Featherine Augustus Aurora is the witch form of Hachijou Tooya (Itouikukuro Zerogonanaroku), and the Witch of Theatergoing, Drama and Spectating, an Endless Witch, and also a Creator.
translation: Featherine Augustus Aurora is the witch form of Hachijou Tooya (Itouikukuro Zerogonanaroku), and the Witch of Theatergoing, Drama and Spectating, an Endless Witch, and also a Creator.
